title: Better Auth (better-auth, @better-auth/kysely-adapter, and @better-auth/drizzle-adapter) before 1.7.16 and…
description: Better Auth versions before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 have a race condition vulnerability involving MySQL or MariaDB serial IDs. The issue arises because the inserted row's ID is retrieved using a separate LAST_INSERT_ID() query that may execute on a different pooled connection. Under concurrent load, this can cause a user signing in to receive another user's session, allowing session hijacking.
